description: This file is a PHP script that handles web UI localization, user authentication, session management, and access control for a network device management interface. It performs locale setting based on environment variables, manages login attempts with lockout features, supports OAuth token validation, and dynamically loads JavaScript resources based on locale.

methods.name: innerIP
methods.description: Checks whether the client's IP address appears to be within the internal network, considering container environments.

methods.name: get_ips
methods.description: Retrieves all IP addresses assigned to a specified network interface.

methods.name: if_type
methods.description: Determines the interface type (LAN, CM, or RG) based on an IP address.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Initializes a user session, setting locale, timeout, and session ID, for authenticated access.

methods.name: getAuthenticationUrl
methods.description: Constructs an OAuth authentication URL with redirect parameters.
